utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case number IT-02-61-A, the Prosecutor versus Miroslav Deronjic. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you very much. Now, the appearances, we'll start with the appellant.

utterances.speaker: MR. CVIJETIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. My name is Slobodan Cvijetic, I am attorney-at-law, and I am Defence counsel for the appellant Mr. Deronjic. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you very much, Mr. Cvijetic. Mr. Deronjic, can you follow the proceedings? THE APPELLANT: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Your Honour. Yes, I do hear you and I understand you. Thank you. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you very much. Now, the appearances for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. GOY
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Barbara Goy appearing for the Prosecution, with senior appeals counsel Mr. Mark McKeon, and our case manager Ms. Susan Grogan. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you, very much. Now, we're having this Status Conference pursuant to Rule 65 bis. The last one was in November 2004 and I understand the status of the case is that there is no pending motion; is that so, for the appellant? So I want to allow the parties to raise any concerns relating to the appeals or the detention conditions.

utterances.speaker: MR. CVIJETIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, according to Mr. Deronjic's application, the Defence intends to raise a matter related to his family. Since this is a sensitive and confidential matter, we will, within reasonable time, in a confidential motion, inform you and the Chamber of what it is about. This is something that falls under the 65 bis rule so we would not wish to raise it here at this Status Conference. Therefore, at this Status Conference, we don't have any matters to raise but we do wish to announce that we will file an application, confidentially, that relates to his family and is a very sensitive and confidential issue. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: Thank you very much. The Prosecution?

utterances.speaker: MS. GOY
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. No, there is nothing we would like to raise. JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA: So the only thing I want to mention is that the Appeals Chamber is aiming to hold the hearing of the case during the month of June, so you can schedule that at least it will not be before June, but if it's on June will depend on the progress of this and other cases. So if there's nothing else to be raised, this Status Conference is adjourned. Thank you very much.
